system.name: BEACON
system.one_liner: A benchmark of 13 RNA tasks across structure, function and engineering for comparing RNA language models with CNN, LSTM and ResNet baselines.

content.variant_note: five lettered zones under grey header pills: task crosshair, database logo wall, baseline lists, task illustrations, metric cards
content.argues: RNA models lack a shared testbed; BEACON offers one: 13 tasks from structure to engineering, public data sources, a common set of baselines and common metrics.
content.subject: A five-zone overview of the benchmark: task map, source databases, baseline models, task illustrations and evaluation metrics.

lessons.what_to_learn: Pin the benchmark name at the origin of a crosshair whose axes are the two task dimensions, place task names in the quadrants and colour them by data size with a four-dot key; titled pills then turn the rest into parallel zones for data, models and metrics.
lessons.suits: multi-task benchmarks and datasets that must show tasks, data sources, baselines and metrics in one overview figure.

evidence: As shown in Fig. 1, BEACON contains a curated collection of 13 important RNA-related tasks
These tasks cover sequence-level and nucleotide-level analyses across three main fields
b: Diverse database distinguished by data size and source type.

summary: BEACON is a benchmark that puts 13 RNA tasks, from secondary structure and contact maps to splice sites, ribosome loading and CRISPR targeting, under one roof so RNA language models can be compared with CNN, LSTM and ResNet baselines. Figure 1 is a five-zone composite on white, each zone titled by a grey pill and lettered. Zone a is a crosshair task map (classification vs regression, nucleotide vs sequence level) whose task names are coloured by data size; b is a wall of source-database logos; d lists the 29+ baselines; c shows each of the 13 tasks as a small drawing under Structure, Function and Engineering; e lists metrics under two mini scatter plots. Labels are tiny, about 4 pt.
summary_zh: BEACON 是首个涵盖 13 项 RNA 任务的综合基准，用来比较 RNA 语言模型与 CNN 等基线。图 1 由五个带灰色标题胶囊的字母分区组成：按数据量着色的任务十字图、数据库标识墙、基线列表、13 项任务插画和评价指标。
notes: Prior labels put contribution-mosaic first but named a scope-overview variant (benchmark-dashboard); the figure is read as a scope-overview dashboard with contribution-mosaic second. The pale-blue boxes of zones d and e are placed as bitmaps (digest). What the three bands of the database wall mean is not stated in the figure. The 13 tasks are counted from the label list; Structural Score Imputation is written on two lines.
